method.fixed_comparison: Expression/ROUND versus fused arithmetic with all four subquery/LATERAL repairs, shared optimized ROUND and filter/projection fix.
method.repair_controls: Same fused arithmetic before/after the NULL guard, ordering and alias repairs. Only cases whose complete validated observation and physical plan match are timed as a before/after repair comparison.
method.planning_scope: SQL parsing, Sail analysis/resolution, DataFusion logical/physical optimization and physical-plan construction in an already registered in-memory session. No table registration or I/O.
method.execution_scope: Consume a fresh physical plan per execution, including scalar subqueries, hash-join build/probe, COUNT/NULL compensation and required sorts. Planning and plan destruction are outside execution timing.
method.counter_scope: Existing FIFO control counts either nine planning calls or nine executions, plus control/loop bookkeeping. Setup, full-row validation, warmups and the other phase are excluded. All physical plans are retained until execution counters stop.
method.retention: All raw timing samples retained. Full-suite samples and selected-case counter runs remain separate.
method.limits: One deterministic in-memory fixture, one machine and one partition. No Delta I/O or concurrent workloads; separate planning/execution phases are not measured end-to-end SQL latency. Invalid pre-repair queries are diagnostics, not performance baselines.

review_source_difference: One comment now describes both perf phases; measured and review benchmark code are otherwise byte-identical.
followup_reason: The main matrix showed a repeatable correlated MAX regression in both ANSI modes. Sixteen additional counter runs measure only those cases, with the same saved binaries and fixture.
